remarks: Prepared to be WOWED with this incredible property (4 car garage, home theatre, sauna) nestled in desirable North Stamford. Spacious, gracious, and beautifully appointed, filled with character and light, this home offers the space, layout and features you want for how we live today. Custom, well equipped gourmet kitchen with oversized island and stainless appliances will delight the serious home chef. Amazing floor plan is perfect for hosting holidays and entertaining. Kitchen leads effortlessly to either the generous dining room or enormous family room. Or up the back stairs to another amazing space with own private bath-perfect for playroom, guest room or nanny. Large living room and fabulous sun room with vaulted ceilings overlooking private patio with hot tub complete the first floor. Upstairs the primary bedroom boasts 2 closets and dazzling, spa-like, just renovated bath with soaking tub, oversized shower and double sink vanity. Right off the primary suite is another room, perfect for a home office. 3 addtional bedrooms on the second floor and 2 additional rooms on the third floor add to the perfection. Love movies? Prepare to be captivated by the dramatic home theatre in the lower level, an additional room currently being used as a craft room/gym, full bath and relax in your own private sauna. AND a 2 car attached garage is complemented by a detached 2 car garage for all of you car enthusiasts. Whole house generator. This lush lifestyle can be yours. Welcome home!
